newsitem.title: USA: Acceptance completes $100 mln credit deal.
newsitem.headline: Acceptance completes $100 mln credit deal.

text.p: Acceptance Insurance Cos Inc said Monday it completed a $100 million revolving credit facility with a group of banks, replacing its current $75 million facility.
The agent on the copmany's credit facility continues to be First Chicago/NBD.
Acceptance also said it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a $65 million preferred security issue for its wholly owned subsidiary AICI Capital Trust.

The preferred securities will be sold to the public as soon as possible, Acceptance said. The principal use of the proceeds will be to reduce the company's revolving credit facility, creating financial flexibility at the holding company level, Acceptance said.
Acceptance is a property and casualty insurance company.
